title: Invoice Add
summary: Invoice creation form with a print-ready invoice card on the left showing company logo, invoice number, date fields, 'Invoice To' and 'Bill To' sections with selects, a line items table with item/cost/qty/price columns and add-item button, salesperson field, and notes textarea. Right sidebar has 'Send Invoice' card with email field and send button, plus payment details card with accepted payment methods and terms.

layout.columns: Left invoice form (~70%) with document-style layout, right action sidebar (~30%) with send and payment cards
